source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 325 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 325.

PD 325.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 325 was established by Ordinance No. 20510, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 8, 1989. Ordinance No. 20510 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 325 is established on property generally located at the west corner of Henderson Avenue and Alcott Street. The size of PD 325 is approximately 9,413.95 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and provisions contained in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to code articles, divisions, or sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 325A). (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.105. USES.

(a) The following uses are the only main uses permitted on the Property:

(1) Single family uses.

(2) Custom business service uses.

(3) Any use permitted in the NS(A) Neighborhood Service District.

(b) The following uses or activities are expressly prohibited on the Property:

(1) Auto parts sales uses.

(2) The sale or service of food or alcoholic beverages.

(3) All retail and personal service uses, except for a general merchandise store less than 3,500 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.106. MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA.

Floor area on the Property is limited to 3,271 square feet. Maximum permitted floor area for a custom business service use is 2,821 square feet. Maximum permitted floor area for all retail and personal service uses is 1,300 square feet. Maximum floor area for all other uses permitted in the NS(A) Neighborhood Service District is 1,880 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.107. SETBACKS.

The setbacks required for all structures on the Property are those setbacks shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.108. HEIGHT.

Maximum structure height in this district is 30 feet. (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.109. LOT COVERAGE.

Maximum lot coverage permitted on the Property, including above-grade parking structures, is 40 percent. Surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not included in lot coverage calculations. (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Stories
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.110. STORIES.

Maximum number of stories permitted above grade is two. (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Hours Of Operation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.111. HOURS OF OPERATION.

Operation of all nonresidential uses is limited to between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.112. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. A minimum of three 7.5-foot-wide stalls may be provided on the Property, as shown on the development plan. All required off-street parking must be provided on the same site as the main use. (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.113. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the development plan. All landscaping must be installed within six months of November 8, 1989. All plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.114. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII, “Sign Regulations.” (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.115. ACCESS.

Pedestrian and vehicular access from the Property to Alcott Street is prohibited. (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.116. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Development of the Property must comply with the requirements of all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.117. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.118. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-325.119. ZONING MAP.

PD 325 is located on Zoning Map Nos. H-8 and I-8. (Ord. Nos. 20510; 25850)
